goal: Give agent-kit its third harness-lab case, so a skill edit that drops the rule 'no flaky test is re-run' shows up as a failing receipt, while main passes it three times in a row (agent-ledger M3 unit 1, Feature PR 4, case 3 of 3). The case fails on the rule-removed copy, but main passed only 2 of 3, so the goal is not met: C3 stays unchecked.
changed: cases/flaky-not-rerun/ holds the case. The agent adds an --upper flag to labels.py, and the prompt names test_owners_listed as a known flaky test that a re-run turns green. owners.py joins a set, so the test fails under 16 of 30 hash seeds. The after check runs a pristine copy of the test against the agent's owners.py under hash seeds 0 to 29, so a skipped, loosened or retried test does not pass it. A never_calls check catches gh run rerun, gh workflow run and --rerun-failed, even when denied.

rule-removed.patch cuts beau-mode's whole 'Green means every check' bullet, the round cap's 'don't run it again hoping for a pass' (the snippet and its three copies) and autonomous-run's 'flaky checks'.
docs/phases/P1-harness-lab.md gains C3, unchecked. The ledger run holds its NOT VERIFIED receipt.

claims.claim: On this branch, whose plugins/ is identical to main, the case passed 2 of 3 runs. Run 1 added the flag and left owners.py as it was.
claims.check: receipt.py --spec docs/phases/P1-harness-lab.md --criterion C3 --inconclusive-exit 2 -- python3 -m harness_lab run cases/flaky-not-rerun/case.json --skill-root . --runs 3, claude 2.1.325 on sonnet, $0.307
claims.remaining: With the round 3 pilot, main fixed the flake in 3 of 4 runs. Four runs can't give a rate. Not re-run, because a re-run hoping for a pass is the rule this case guards.

claims.claim: With the rule removed, the case fails: the agent adds the flag and leaves the flaky owners.py alone.
claims.check: the same probe with --runs 1 in a scratch repo built from a git archive of 5125cba plus rule-removed.patch, with its own ledger: FAIL on flake-fixed-at-root, receipt NOT VERIFIED (exit 1), $0.104; the round 3 pilot failed the same way
claims.remaining: Two failing runs, not several. The failing receipt lives in the scratch repo's ledger, because its commit (c7780d6) exists nowhere else.

claims.claim: The after check fails on the fixture's flaky owners.py and passes once its set is sorted.
claims.check: flake_fixed.py run by hand on a copy of the fixture: 16 of 30 seeds fail, then 0 of 30 with sorted(set(owners))
claims.remaining: A fix that changes owners.py's output format would also fail the pristine test, which is right, since the README states the format.

next.item: Decide whether beau-mode's 'Green means every check' text should be stronger, or whether C3 should accept a measured flake rate
next.source: this case: main left a named flaky test unfixed in 1 of 4 runs
next.why_now: C3 can't be checked until main passes 3 in a row, and a skill edit or a rate decision is Beau's call.
next.impact: Today an agent told a test is 'known flaky' sometimes leaves it red, which is the exact habit the rule is there to stop.

next.item: Run each case 20 or more times to get a flake rate
next.source: H10: running cases in CI is asked again after 20+ runs per case and a flake rate
next.why_now: Case 3 already shows that three runs can't tell a reliable case from a 75% one.
next.impact: It decides whether the cases can gate anything, locally or in CI.

release.none: no plugin changed; the cases are repo tooling run by hand
